name: manifund-remote
description: Remote-API judge lanes over the Manifund grantmaking corpus, complementing the local-GPU manifund-3mo campaign with independent commercial judges. GLM (z.ai coding-plan) drives canonical_bucket_v1 direction+ratio_bucket judgments; GLM returns no output logprobs (censused in model_supports_logprobs) so no PMF posterior lands, but direction and ratio land into ratiometer.judgments, content-addressed and resumable from the ledger. Each phase authenticates via api_key_env against the coding endpoint. Budgets are per-attribute stopping caps sized to sit inside the Lite weekly credit envelope; raise once real consumption is measured. MiniMax lanes activate once the Token Plan payment clears.
